multi_entity_note: Fox Mobile Entertainment / Twentieth Century Fox Licensing & Merchandising and Glu Mobile, Inc. (f/k/a Sorrent), plus VGSL.
processing_note: With respect to KOH Video Clips which Licensee distributes to VGSL, VGSL will remit directly to Fox, Fox's contractual share (pursuant to the VGSL Agreement ) of such VGSL Revenue.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document names itself Amendment No. 1; the Wireless Content License Agreement is the underlying agreement it amends.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The amendment is 'Dated as of November 11, 2005'; December 16, 2004 is the underlying agreement's date and the November 18, 2005 signatures differ from it.

contract.effective_date.rationale: No separate effective date is given; the amendment takes effect as of its 'Dated as of' date, November 11, 2005.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: No expiration date of a term is stated; the listed dates are exclusivity limits, the assignment date and filing footers.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The amendment has no governing-law clause.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term; the twelve months is a video-clip distribution period.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period to prevent renewal is stated.
